sources_disclaimer: Community-scraped datasets are included for research and educational purposes. Always verify drug information against the official
src_eda_desc: The official regulatory authority overseeing drugs and medical devices in Egypt. MedLens AI uses EDA-listed drug data as the authoritative reference for all drug safety, interactions, and pricing information.
src_karem_desc: An open-source community dataset built by scraping and structuring drug records from the EDA website. Used as a supplementary structured data source in MedLens AI drug knowledge base.
src_falous_desc: Another community-built scraping project capturing Egyptian drug data from EDA. Provides additional coverage and cross-referencing for the MedLens drug retrieval corpus.
src_ada_desc: Primary source for dermatological disease information in MedLens AI. ADA clinical protocols and disease management guidelines form the core of the diseases knowledge base, covering Eczema, Psoriasis, Urticaria, and related skin conditions.
src_guidelines_desc: Curated clinical guidelines covering Eczema, Psoriasis, and Urticaria. Focused on management protocols relevant to the Egyptian climate and patient population, including environmental and seasonal factors.
src_chroma_desc: Local semantic vector database powering MedLens AI RAG retrieval system. All drug and disease data is chunked and indexed using the BAAI/bge-m3 multilingual embedding model (Dense 1024-d) with cosine similarity search.
terms_disclaimer_desc: MedLens AI is designed exclusively to assist qualified healthcare professionals in Egypt with dermatology-related clinical decisions. It is NOT a replacement for professional medical judgment, diagnosis, or treatment.
terms_disclaimer_li1: Information is based on curated clinical guidelines and may not cover all patient scenarios.
terms_disclaimer_li2: Always verify drug interactions, dosages, and contraindications against the latest Egyptian Drug Authority (EDA) formularies.
terms_disclaimer_li3: Recommendations must be interpreted in the context of individual patient circumstances.
terms_ai_title: AI Processing - Powered by Groq API
terms_ai_desc: MedLens AI uses Groq's large language model API to process your medical queries and generate clinical recommendations. By using MedLens AI, you acknowledge and agree that:
terms_ai_li1: Your queries are transmitted to Groq's servers for processing and are subject to Groq's Terms of Service and Privacy Policy (groq.com/terms-of-service).
terms_ai_li2: Groq may process your query data in accordance with their data handling practices.
terms_ai_li3: Do NOT include personally identifiable patient information (names, national IDs, phone numbers) in your queries - describe clinical scenarios only.
terms_data_desc: By using MedLens AI, you agree that the MedLens team may collect and use anonymized interaction data, including:
terms_data_li1: Query patterns: The types of clinical questions asked (anonymized, no patient identifiers).
terms_data_li2: System performance data: Response quality metrics, error rates, and retrieval accuracy.
terms_data_li3: Profile metadata: Age group, gender distribution (aggregated) to improve recommendations for Egyptian dermatology patients.
terms_data_footer: This data is used exclusively to improve MedLens AI. It is never sold or shared with third parties outside the MedLens team. You may request deletion of your account and associated data at any time.
terms_privacy_li1: Your session and profile are stored locally in your browser's storage for convenience and offline access.
terms_privacy_li2: Conversation summaries (working memory) are stored locally and never uploaded to MedLens servers unless you explicitly send a query.
terms_privacy_li3: You can sign out at any time to clear all local session data.
